user_stories.goal: Read, write and remove metadata on ReGa objects (Interface.getMetadata/setMetadata/removeMetadata) and on interface-stored objects (Interface.getMetadata_crRFD/setMetadata_crRFD)
requirements: GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Interface.getMetadata is called with objectId and dataId THEN a ReGa script returns o.MetaData(dataId) for dom.GetObject(objectId) as a JSON string (getmetadata.tcl:13-23; methods.conf:439-444)
GIVEN the objectId does not resolve to a ReGa object WHEN getMetadata runs THEN the string 'No metadata available' is returned (getmetadata.tcl:18-20)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Interface.setMetadata is called THEN existing metadata dataId is removed then re-added with value on the ReGa object and the string '<dataId>: <value>' is returned (setmetadata.tcl:11-27; methods.conf:432-437)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and an existing metadata entry WHEN Interface.removeMetadata is called THEN it is removed and '<objectId> - matadata <dataId> successfully deleted!' is returned (removemetadata.tcl:10-21; methods.conf:462-467)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Interface.setMetadata_crRFD is called with interface, objectId, dataId, value THEN xmlrpc setMetadata is invoked and its raw result is returned (setmetadata_crRFD.tcl:12-18; methods.conf:446-452); a GUEST session can read via getMetadata_crRFD (getmetadata_crRFD.tcl:11-16; methods.conf:454-460)
edge_cases: WHEN Interface.setMetadata targets an objectId that does not exist THEN the script creates a new ReGa object (OT_OBJECT) named objectId and stores the metadata on it, i.e. a write side effect creating arbitrary named objects (setmetadata.tcl:19-23)

WHEN removeMetadata targets a missing object THEN 'o.MetaData(dataId)' is evaluated on a null object (no null check at removemetadata.tcl:11-12); hmscript_run returns '' on script failure (hmscript.tcl:33-37), so the response would be '""' (ReGa behavior on the null dereference unverified)

WHEN the three ReGa-based methods are called THEN they are registered with SCRIPT_FILE pointing directly to the method file (not dispatch.tcl), so no 'interface' argument is needed or validated (methods.conf:432-467)

WHEN the crRFD variants call xmlrpc THEN they are not wrapped in checkXmlRpcStatus: faults raise a Tcl error returned as 200 internal error; setMetadata_crRFD passes $value raw instead of [list string $value] and returns the unquoted raw result (setmetadata_crRFD.tcl:16-18; getmetadata_crRFD.tcl:14-16)
WHEN value or dataId contain quotes/backslashes/newlines THEN hmscript_escapeString escapes them before injection as ReGa 'var' declarations (hmscript.tcl:62-71)
WHEN getMetadata is called at GUEST level THEN any ReGa object's metadata can be read by object id (methods.conf:439-440)

input_shape.objectId: string; ReGa object id or name, usually a device/channel serial or address

output_shape.crRFD variants: raw XML-RPC result (unquoted for set, JSON string for get)

user_stories.goal: Read the ReGa device model: device ids, single-device detail, bulk detail with channels, new-device count and address lookups (Device.listAll, listAllDetail, get, getNewDeviceCount, getReGaIDByAddress, getRFAddressByAddress, getRFAddressOfAllDevices)
requirements: GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Device.listAll is called THEN the ids of all ReGa devices with ReadyConfig()==true are returned as a JSON string array (listall.tcl:12-38; methods.conf:497-501)

GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Device.listAllDetail is called THEN for each ready device with an existing interface a separate ReGa script is executed and a device object {id,name,address,interface,type,operateGroupOnly,isReady,channels[]} is built, each channel carrying id,name,address,deviceId,index,partnerId,mode,category,isReady,isUsable,isVisible,isLogged,isLogable,isReadable,isWritable,isEventable,isAesAvailable,isVirtual,channelType (listalldetail.tcl:170-282; methods.conf:503-508)
GIVEN a GUEST session and device id WHEN Device.get is called THEN the same device/channel model for a single device is returned (device/get.tcl:17-177; methods.conf:510-515)

GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Device.getNewDeviceCount is called THEN the count of enabled devices that are not ReadyConfig and not named 'Gateway' is returned as a JSON string (getnewdevicecount.tcl:13-28; methods.conf:490-495)
GIVEN an ADMIN session and a serial address WHEN Device.getReGaIDByAddress is called THEN the matching device ID() is returned (getregaidbyaddress.tcl:13-26; methods.conf:524-529)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.getRFAddressByAddress or Device.getRFAddressOfAllDevices is called THEN the RF_ADDRESS token(s) parsed from the DEVDESC metadata are returned (getrfaddressbyaddress.tcl:13-38; getrfaddressofalldevices.tcl:13-36)
GIVEN Device.get is called with an id that has no matching ReGa device WHEN the script returns no NAME THEN jsonrpc_error 501 'device not found' is returned (device/get.tcl:129-131)
edge_cases: WHEN Device.listAllDetail executes THEN one hmscript (ReGa) round-trip is made per device (N+1 pattern) and any device whose script output cannot be parsed into an array is silently skipped (listalldetail.tcl:188-208)

WHEN Device.listAllDetail reads a device whose operateGroupOnly metadata is null THEN the read call writes it (AddMetaData operateGroupOnly=false); for HmIP-DRG-DALI and HmIP-FALMOT channels it also writes maxCap/chnActive defaults, so a GUEST-level read mutates ReGa metadata (listalldetail.tcl:33-35, 147, 158)

WHEN a channel Label contains 'HmIP-FALMOT' with channelType CLIMATECONTROL_FLOOR_TRANSCEIVER but is not exactly HmIP-FALMOT-C8/C12 THEN the Tcl side reads channel(FALMOT_CHN_ACTIVE) which the ReGa side never wrote, raising a Tcl error that fails the whole list as 200 internal error (listalldetail.tcl:152, 268-270)
WHEN isVirtual is computed THEN listAllDetail also flags Label 'HmIP-RCV-50' as virtual while Device.get flags only ChannelType()==29 (listalldetail.tcl:94 vs device/get.tcl:95)
WHEN GROUP_PARTNER_ID is 65535 THEN partnerId is emitted as an empty string (device/get.tcl:148-149; listalldetail.tcl:234-235)

WHEN Device.getReGaIDByAddress finds no device THEN the literal 'noDeviceFound' is returned as a normal result; getRFAddressByAddress returns 'unknown' (getregaidbyaddress.tcl:15; getrfaddressbyaddress.tcl:15, 30-34)

WHEN Device.getRFAddressOfAllDevices runs THEN it calls 'hmscript $script' without args and returns a tab/newline separated string 'RF_ADDRESS..<tab>address<tab>name<newline>' per device (getrfaddressofalldevices.tcl:28, 36)
WHEN ReGa script fails or returns nothing for Device.listAll / getNewDeviceCount THEN hmscript_run returns '' and an empty array / quoted empty string is returned (hmscript.tcl:33-37)
WHEN device channels include Internal() channels THEN they are excluded from channel lists (device/get.tcl:47; listalldetail.tcl:46)
WHEN the ReGa field isReady for the device is emitted in listAllDetail THEN it is a quoted string, whereas channel isReady is an unquoted raw ReGa boolean (listalldetail.tcl:222 vs 246)

output_shape.listAllDetail / get: device: {id: string, name: string, address: string, interface: string, type: string, operateGroupOnly: string ('true'|'false'|''), isReady?: string, channels: channel[]}; channel: {id, name, address, deviceId: string, index: integer, partnerId: string, mode: 'MODE_DEFAULT'|'MODE_AES', category: 'CATEGORY_NONE'|'CATEGORY_SENDER'|'CATEGORY_RECEIVER', isReady, isUsable, isVisible, isLogged, isLogable, isReadable, isWritable, isEventable, isAesAvailable, isVirtual: boolean (raw ReGa token), channelType: string, mode_multi_mode?: string, daliMaxCapabilities?: string, isChannelActive?: boolean}

user_stories.goal: Mutate ReGa device and channel attributes: names, visibility, usability, logging, AES mode and operate-group-only flag (Device.setName, setVisibility, setOperateGroupOnly; Channel.setName, setVisibility, setUsability, setLogging, setMode)
requirements: GIVEN an ADMIN session, device/channel id and name WHEN Device.setName or Channel.setName is called THEN the ReGa object's Name() is set and the resulting (possibly uniquified) name is returned as a JSON string (device/setname.tcl:16-25; channel/setname.tcl:17-26; methods.conf:517-522, 714-719)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.setVisibility / Channel.setVisibility is called with isVisible THEN Visible(bool) is set and the resulting boolean is returned as JSON true/false (device/setvisibility.tcl:10-28; channel/setvisibility.tcl:10-28)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.setUsability is called with isUsable THEN UserAccessRights(iulOtherThanAdmin) is set to iarFullAccess (true) or iarRead (otherwise) and the effective state is returned as true/false (channel/setusability.tcl:10-34; methods.conf:741-746)
GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.setLogging is called with isLogged THEN ChnArchive(bool) is set and the effective state returned as true/false (channel/setlogging.tcl:10-28)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.setMode is called with mode 'MODE_AES' THEN ChnAESActive(true) is set, otherwise ChnAESActive(false), and 'MODE_AES' or 'MODE_DEFAULT' is returned (channel/setmode.tcl:10-37)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.setOperateGroupOnly is called with mode 'true' THEN metadata operateGroupOnly=true is written, otherwise false (device/setoperategrouponly.tcl:11-22; methods.conf:567-572)

GIVEN the ReGa script yields neither 'true' nor 'false' (or the AES mode names) WHEN the *Visibility, setUsability, setLogging or setMode methods run THEN jsonrpc_error 500 'homematic script error' is returned (e.g. channel/setvisibility.tcl:24-28; channel/setmode.tcl:33-37)
edge_cases: WHEN Channel.setName or Channel.setMode is called THEN methods.conf lists only {_session_id_ id} in ARGUMENTS, so the required 'name' / 'mode' argument is not enforced (402 is not raised) and the ReGa variable is simply undefined (methods.conf:714-719, 762-767); resulting ReGa behavior unverified

WHEN a flag argument is the JSON boolean true THEN it arrives as the string 'true' and only the exact string 'true' sets the flag; any other value (including '1', 'True') means false (device/setvisibility.tcl:12; channel/setusability.tcl:12; channel/setlogging.tcl:12)
WHEN Device.setName or Channel.setName gets an id with no object THEN the script writes nothing and '""' is returned (no error) (device/setname.tcl:18-22)

WHEN Device.setOperateGroupOnly succeeds THEN the script writes nothing, so the result is the quoted empty string; it also returns '""' when the device does not exist (device/setoperategrouponly.tcl:15-22)
WHEN a name is not unique THEN ReGa uniquifies it and the returned name differs from the input (device/setname.tcl:12 doc)
WHEN Channel.setMode sets AES but the channel does not support it THEN the effective mode read back may remain MODE_DEFAULT (channel/setmode.tcl:20-27)
WHEN unusual characters appear in name THEN hmscript_escapeString escapes backslash, quotes, CR, LF, tab before ReGa injection (hmscript.tcl:62-71)
WHEN id is not found for visibility/usability/logging/mode THEN empty script output leads to 500 'homematic script error' (channel/setvisibility.tcl:27)

user_stories.goal: Report program/link usage of devices and channels and read channel facts (Device.hasPrograms, hasLinksOrPrograms, listProgramIds; Channel.hasProgramIds, listProgramIds, getName, getValue, getChannelType)
requirements: GIVEN a GUEST session and device id WHEN Device.listProgramIds is called THEN the de-duplicated ids of all programs using any non-internal channel of the device are returned as a JSON string array (device/listprogramids.tcl:13-44; methods.conf:560-565)
GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.hasPrograms is called THEN true is returned iff any channel has ChnDPUsageCount() > 0 (device/hasprograms.tcl:12-35; methods.conf:553-558)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.hasLinksOrPrograms is called THEN true is returned if the device is used in programs; otherwise, if it has links, each channel>0 is queried over XML-RPC and true is returned iff a link peer belongs to a different parent device (not starting with '@') (haslinksorprograms.tcl:88-145; methods.conf:545-551)

GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Channel.hasProgramIds is called THEN raw true/false is returned depending on whether ChnEnumDPUsagePrograms() is non-empty (channel/hasprogramids.tcl:12-25; methods.conf:707-712)
GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Channel.listProgramIds is called THEN the program ids using the channel are returned as a string array (channel/listprogramids.tcl:12-39; methods.conf:700-705)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.getName is called with a channel address THEN the name of the first enabled+visible channel with that Address() is returned (channel/getname.tcl:12-37; methods.conf:721-726)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.getValue / Channel.getChannelType is called with id THEN obj.State() / obj.HssType() is returned as a JSON string (channel/getvalue.tcl:12-21; channel/getchanneltype.tcl:12-21; methods.conf:727-739)
edge_cases: WHEN Device.hasLinksOrPrograms handles a device on an interface other than BidCos-RF, BidCos-Wired, HmIP-RF or HmIP-Wired THEN getIfaceURL leaves ifaceList unset and 'can't read ifaceList(URL)' is raised -> 200 internal error (haslinksorprograms.tcl:13-22, 95)
WHEN a channel in hasLinksOrPrograms has direction other than 1/2 THEN the loop breaks and further links of that channel are ignored (haslinksorprograms.tcl:116-124)
WHEN hasLinksOrPrograms iterates links THEN getDeviceDescription is requested once per link for the same channel inside the loop (haslinksorprograms.tcl:110-113)

WHEN the device id is unknown THEN the Device.hasPrograms script guards with 'if (device)' and returns 'false', while Device.listProgramIds calls device.Channels() without a null check (device/hasprograms.tcl:16; device/listprogramids.tcl:14-18); the outcome of that null dereference in ReGa is unverified
WHEN Channel.hasProgramIds finds no channel THEN the script prints nothing and result is null (channel/hasprogramids.tcl:14-25; jsonrpc.tcl:87-91)
WHEN Channel.getName gets a hidden channel (not visible) THEN it is excluded by EnumEnabledVisibleIDs() and '""' is returned (channel/getname.tcl:23)
WHEN Channel.getValue / getChannelType id is not found THEN '""' is returned without error (channel/getvalue.tcl:14-17)

WHEN the stale copy www/api/methods/device/hasprograms.tcl is compared THEN it lacks the 'break' after hasPrograms = 'true' at line 22 (functionally the same result, loop continues) (device/hasprograms.tcl:22)

user_stories.goal: Start and poll communication (function) tests for devices and channels (Device.startComTest/pollComTest, Channel.startComTest/pollComTest)
requirements: GIVEN a GUEST session and device id WHEN Device.startComTest is called THEN the current time 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' is returned as the test id and DevStartComTest() is triggered (device/startcomtest.tcl:12-25; methods.conf:574-579)
GIVEN a GUEST session and channel id WHEN Channel.startComTest is called THEN the same test id is returned and ChnStartComTest() is triggered (channel/startcomtest.tcl:12-24; methods.conf:769-774)

GIVEN a started test WHEN Device.pollComTest(id,testId) is called and LastTestCompletedTime() >= testId THEN that completion timestamp is returned as a JSON string; otherwise raw JSON false is returned (device/pollcomtest.tcl:13-36; methods.conf:581-586)

GIVEN a started test WHEN Channel.pollComTest(id,testId) is called and TestCompletedTime() >= testId THEN the timestamp is returned, otherwise false (channel/pollcomtest.tcl:14-37; methods.conf:776-781)

GIVEN the ReGa object does not exist WHEN any of the four methods runs THEN the script prints nothing and jsonrpc_error 500 'homematic script error' is returned (device/startcomtest.tcl:24-28; device/pollcomtest.tcl:33; channel/pollcomtest.tcl:34)
edge_cases: WHEN testId is an arbitrary non-timestamp string THEN the ReGa >= comparison is evaluated on whatever types ReGa derives; no validation occurs (device/pollcomtest.tcl:15-19)
WHEN the clock of the CCU changes between start and poll THEN comparison may be wrong because the test id is wall-clock time with one-second resolution (device/startcomtest.tcl:17)

WHEN Device.startComTest or Channel.startComTest runs THEN the test id is written before DevStartComTest()/ChnStartComTest() is invoked, so the id is returned regardless of whether the test could be started (device/startcomtest.tcl:17-18; channel/startcomtest.tcl:16-17)
WHEN the doc comment of startComTest says 'Id des Kanals' for Device.startComTest THEN the argument is a device id (device/startcomtest.tcl:6)
WHEN comtest methods are called at GUEST level THEN guests can trigger RF transmissions (methods.conf:574-575, 769-770)

user_stories.goal: Per-session event queue: subscribe, poll and unsubscribe through file-backed queues under /tmp/event, with events produced by event_fire (init on subscribe, delete from hm_deldev)
requirements: GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Event.subscribe is called THEN the session's queue file /tmp/event/<sid> is truncated, the subscriber list /tmp/event/subscriber.list gets <sid> -> {EVENT_COUNT 0}, event_fire 'init' is queued to subscribers and true is returned (subscribe.tcl:32-58; methods.conf:595-600)
GIVEN queued events for the session WHEN Event.poll is called THEN /tmp/event/<sid> is read, truncated and returned as [{type: <string>, data: <raw JSON>}] (poll.tcl:6-34; methods.conf:609-614)

GIVEN a subscribed session WHEN Event.unsubscribe is called THEN its queue file is deleted, its entry is removed from subscriber.list and true is returned (unsubscribe.tcl:13-27; methods.conf:602-607)

GIVEN a device is deleted WHEN rega/bin/hm_deldev runs THEN event_fire delete with data '"<device>"' appends a {TYPE delete DATA "<device>"} line to every subscriber queue whose EVENT_COUNT is below the limit 64 (eq3/event.tcl:22-43; src/webui/rega/bin/hm_deldev:17)
GIVEN the lock cannot be obtained WHEN subscribe/unsubscribe run THEN false is returned (unsubscribe.tcl:14-25 doc) and WHEN poll runs THEN '[]' is returned (poll.tcl:7-18)
edge_cases: WHEN Event.subscribe validates other subscribers THEN isValid loads 'common/checksid.hms' (subscribe.tcl:25) but the only checksid.hms in the tree is api/eq3/checksid.hms (no api/common/ directory exists), so file_load returns '' and the ReGa script contains only variable declarations, returning '' instead of 'true': every other registered session id is considered invalid, removed from subscriber.list and its queue file deleted (subscribe.tcl:41-47; eq3/common.tcl:59-69; eq3/hmscript.tcl:46-60). Each Event.subscribe therefore evicts all other sessions' subscriptions

WHEN Event.subscribe loops over subscribers THEN result is first set to the quoted string '"<id> a"' (line 42, debug residue) and only becomes true after the loop; if file_save or another statement inside catch raises, the response is that quoted string instead of true/false (subscribe.tcl:42, 52, 58)

WHEN lock_tryget is called THEN it always returns 1 because the proc ends with 'return 1' regardless of the open result, so the lock never blocks concurrent subscribe/poll/fire writers (eq3/common.tcl:89-101)

WHEN a subscriber has received 64 events THEN event_fire stops writing to its queue silently; Event.poll never resets EVENT_COUNT in subscriber.list, so the subscriber must re-subscribe to receive more (eq3/event.tcl:32-36; poll.tcl:6-16)

WHEN Event.unsubscribe is called for a session not in subscriber.list THEN 'unset subscriberList($id)' raises inside catch, subscriber.list is not rewritten and false is returned (unsubscribe.tcl:17-23)

WHEN event data is emitted THEN data is inserted into the JSON verbatim (not escaped); hm_deldev embeds the unescaped device argument inside quotes, so a device name with a quote or backslash produces invalid JSON in Event.poll (poll.tcl:27; hm_deldev:17)
WHEN subscriber ids are used as file names THEN _session_id_ is joined into /tmp/event/<sid> without sanitisation (subscribe.tcl:37; poll.tcl:11; unsubscribe.tcl:19)
WHEN the module event.tcl is loaded and subscriber.list does not exist THEN /tmp/event is created and the list file is truncated/created (eq3/event.tcl:49-52)
WHEN event_fire is called by Event.subscribe THEN it is called with the lock held; with the always-1 lock_tryget this does not deadlock (subscribe.tcl:54; eq3/event.tcl:25)

input_shape._session_id_: string; used as queue file name and subscriber key

output_shape.subscribe/unsubscribe: boolean (subscribe may return a quoted string on internal failure)
output_shape.poll: array<{type: string ('init'|'delete'|...), data: raw JSON value (null for init, string for delete)}>

user_stories.goal: Read and rewrite the BidCoS-RF (rfd.conf) and BidCoS-Wired (hs485d.conf) gateway configuration, manage the system security key file and prepare LAN gateway key changes (BidCoS_RF.getConfigurationRF/setConfigurationRF/createKeyFile/isKeySet/validateKey, BidCoS_Wired.getConfigurationWired/setConfigurationWired, BidCoS.changeLanGatewayKey)
requirements: GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN BidCoS_RF.getConfigurationRF is called THEN /etc/config/rfd.conf is parsed into sections and {interfaces:[{type,userName,serialNumber,encryptionKey,ipAddress}]} is returned for every section whose Type is not 'CCU2' (getconfiguration-rf.tcl:20-119; methods.conf:910-915)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN BidCoS_Wired.getConfigurationWired is called THEN /etc/config/hs485d.conf is parsed likewise, with no Type filtering (getconfiguration-wired.tcl:20-119; methods.conf:1179-1184)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and interfaces[] WHEN BidCoS_RF.setConfigurationRF is called THEN rfd.conf is rewritten: header lines before the first '[Interface N]' (N in 1-9 digits) are kept and one '[Interface i]' section per element (Type, Name, Serial Number, Encryption Key, optional IP Address) is appended from i=1; true is returned (setconfiguration-rf.tcl:15-69; methods.conf:917-922)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and interfaces[] WHEN BidCoS_Wired.setConfigurationWired is called THEN hs485d.conf is rewritten the same way with interface numbering from 0 and a generated header if the file does not exist; true is returned (setconfiguration-wired.tcl:15-85; methods.conf:1186-1191)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and key WHEN BidCoS_RF.createKeyFile is called THEN /etc/config/keys is written with Current Index, 'Key 0 =', the md5 hex of the key for the current and previous indexes reported by 'crypttool -g', and Last Index (createkeyfile.tcl:13-62; methods.conf:924-929)
GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN BidCoS_RF.validateKey(key) is called THEN `crypttool -v -t 3 -k <key>` is executed and false is returned if it exits non-zero, otherwise true (validatekey.tcl:10-14)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and a non-empty lgwserial WHEN BidCoS.changeLanGatewayKey is called THEN /etc/config//<lgwserial>.keychange is written with Class, Serial, IP, KEY, CURKEY lines and true is returned; with an empty lgwserial false is returned (changeLanGatewayKey.tcl:21-38; methods.conf:1192-1198)
edge_cases: WHEN BidCoS_RF.setConfigurationRF is called and /etc/config/rfd.conf cannot be opened THEN the first 'open r' raises and 200 internal error is returned; if the file is readable but empty the variable 'header' is unset and 'puts $fd $header' fails after the file was already truncated by 'open w', leaving rfd.conf empty (setconfiguration-rf.tcl:18-33)

WHEN an element in interfaces[] is malformed THEN the foreach is wrapped in catch, result becomes false but the already truncated/partially written file is closed and kept; no rollback exists (setconfiguration-rf.tcl:38-67, setconfiguration-wired.tcl:54-83)
WHEN interface field values contain newlines THEN they are written verbatim, allowing extra config lines to be injected into rfd.conf / hs485d.conf (setconfiguration-rf.tcl:48-55)

WHEN setConfigurationRF searches for the header end THEN the pattern '\[Interface [1-9]*\]' does not match '[Interface 0]', so Interface 0 stays in the retained header; the wired variant matches '[0-9]*' and drops all interface sections (setconfiguration-rf.tcl:20; setconfiguration-wired.tcl:29)

WHEN getConfiguration-* parses a file THEN a line like 'x = [y]' matches the section regexp anywhere in the line and starts a new section; comment lines starting with '#' are skipped; an unreadable file yields interfaces:[] (getconfiguration-rf.tcl:36-48, 30-58)
WHEN getConfigurationRF/Wired respond THEN encryptionKey (LAN gateway access code) is returned in clear text (getconfiguration-rf.tcl:109)
WHEN BidCoS_RF.isKeySet runs THEN result is true exactly when `crypttool -v -t 0` exits non-zero, i.e. the boolean mirrors the failure of the verification command (iskeyset.tcl:7-12)
WHEN BidCoS_RF.validateKey runs THEN the key is passed as a command line argument of crypttool (exec list form, no shell), visible in the process list (validatekey.tcl:10)

WHEN createKeyFile computes index THEN a missing 'Current user key' / 'Previous user key' line in crypttool -g output yields index 0 and the corresponding Key line is not written (createkeyfile.tcl:36-56)

WHEN changeLanGatewayKey receives an lgwserial containing '/' or '..' THEN the file path is built by string concatenation without sanitisation, allowing writes of '<...>.keychange' files outside /etc/config; newkey/curkey are stored in clear text (changeLanGatewayKey.tcl:25-33)
WHEN changeLanGatewayKey runs THEN the md5 package is not loaded (commented) and no hashing is applied to the key (changeLanGatewayKey.tcl:16, 23)

WHEN the wired config does not exist and EQ3_SERVICE_HS485D_PORT is defined by /etc/eq3services.ports.tcl THEN that port is used in the generated header, else 2000 (setconfiguration-wired.tcl:17-21, 36-44)

input_shape.interfaces: array<{type: string, userName: string, serialNumber: string, encryptionKey: string, ipAddress?: string}> (set*)

output_shape.get*Configuration: {interfaces: array<{type: string, userName: string, serialNumber: string, encryptionKey: string, ipAddress: string}>}

user_stories.goal: Session.login/logout/renew/setSessionVar (and the unregistered Session.create) manage ReGa web sessions by calling the local lighttpd login page and the ReGa session functions
requirements: GIVEN valid username/password WHEN Session.login (LEVEL NONE, methods.conf:783-788) is called THEN the script POSTs tbUsername/tbPassword via ::http::geturl -query to http://127.0.0.1/login.htm (login.tcl:15,45), extracts the session id with regexp 'sid=@([^@]*)@' from the Location header (login.tcl:46,54) and returns it as a JSON string via json_toString (login.tcl:58) (happy path)

GIVEN the login page answers with an HTTP status line containing '503' WHEN Session.login runs THEN jsonrpc_error 503 'service not available' is returned and the script exits (login.tcl:47,50-52) (failure path)

GIVEN wrong credentials or the session limit is reached (no 'sid=@...@' in Location) WHEN Session.login runs THEN jsonrpc_error 501 'invalid credentials or too many sessions' (login.tcl:54-56) (failure path)

GIVEN a session id WHEN Session.logout (LEVEL NONE, methods.conf:790-795, ARGUMENTS {_session_id_}) runs THEN hmscript executes system.ClearSessionID(_session_id_) (logout.tcl:12) and the response is always true (logout.tcl:14) regardless of whether the id existed (happy path)

GIVEN a valid session of at least GUEST level WHEN Session.renew (LEVEL GUEST, methods.conf:797-802) runs THEN a loopback GET http://127.0.0.1/pages/index.htm?sid=@<sid>@ is issued and discarded (renew.tcl:15-17) and the response is true (renew.tcl:19) (happy path)

GIVEN an expired/unknown session id WHEN Session.renew is called THEN the dispatcher's privilege check (getupl.hms yields 0 < GUEST=1) rejects it with error 400 'access denied ("GUEST" needed 0)' before the script runs (homematic.cgi:103-117) (failure path)

GIVEN params var and val WHEN Session.setSessionVar (LEVEL GUEST, ARGUMENTS {var val}, methods.conf:804-809) runs THEN hmscript executes system.SetSessionVar(var,val) with all params injected as script variables and returns true (setsessionvar.tcl:11-13) (happy path)

GIVEN Session.setSessionVar is called without _session_id_ WHEN the dispatcher runs checkPrivilegeLevel (it reads args(_session_id_) for every non-NONE method) THEN a Tcl error is raised and returned as error 200 'internal error:...' although ARGUMENTS does not list _session_id_ (homematic.cgi:108-110,155; methods.conf:808) (failure path)
edge_cases: WHEN Session.login is called with missing username or password THEN dispatcher returns 402 'missing argument (<name>)' (ARGUMENTS {username password}, homematic.cgi:127-130)
WHEN the loopback connection to 127.0.0.1 fails THEN ::http::geturl raises a Tcl error and the caller receives error 200 'internal error:' + errorInfo (login.tcl:45, homematic.cgi:155)
WHEN Session.login is called with a session id containing '@' characters in Location THEN the regexp [^@]* captures only up to the next '@' (login.tcl:54)
WHEN Session.renew is called for a valid session THEN the response is true regardless of whether the GET produced a refreshed session (renew.tcl:17-19)

session/create.tcl (Session.create, 'Erstellt eine neue Sitzung') is NOT registered in methods.conf (no SCRIPT_FILE session/create.tcl entry) so it is unreachable through homematic.cgi; its body would request http://127.0.0.1/login.htm without credentials and return error 501 'could not create session <location> <array>' on failure (create.tcl:14,39-48)
Session.login passes credentials in an application/x-www-form-urlencoded request body built by ::http::formatQuery, so reserved characters are percent-encoded (login.tcl:45)

user_stories.goal: Method registry introspection (system.describe, system.listMethods, system.methodHelp) and the per-method privilege matrix declared in methods.conf for the methods in this partition
requirements: GIVEN any caller (LEVEL NONE, methods.conf:1-6) WHEN system.describe runs THEN it returns an object {name:'HomeMatic JSON API', id:'urn:www-homematic-com:homematic-jsonrpc-api', summary:'Zugriff auf HomeMatic Zentrale', help:'/api/homematic.cgi', procs:[{name,level,summary}...]} with procs sorted by name from METHOD_LIST (describe.tcl:16-38) (happy path)

GIVEN any caller WHEN system.listMethods (LEVEL NONE, methods.conf:8-13) runs THEN it returns an array of {name, level, info} for every registry entry, sorted lexicographically by name (listmethods.tcl:16-32) (happy path)
GIVEN name='CCU.getVersion' WHEN system.methodHelp (LEVEL NONE, ARGUMENTS {name}, methods.conf:15-20) runs THEN it returns the INFO text as a JSON string (methodhelp.tcl:14,20) (happy path)
GIVEN a name not present in METHOD_LIST WHEN system.methodHelp runs THEN jsonrpc_error 500 'unknown method (<name>)' (methodhelp.tcl:16-18) (failure path)

GIVEN a caller whose session level is below the method's LEVEL WHEN any method of this partition is called THEN the dispatcher answers error 400 'access denied ("<LEVEL>" needed <callerLevel>)' (homematic.cgi:114-116). Level values NONE=0, GUEST=1, USER=2, ADMIN=8 (homematic.cgi:59-62) (failure path)

GIVEN any caller WHEN the privilege matrix is read from methods.conf THEN NONE = system.describe, system.listMethods, system.methodHelp, system.getEnergyPrice, Session.login, Session.logout, ReGa.isPresent, WebUI.getColors, User.getReGaVersion; GUEST = Session.renew, Session.setSessionVar, CCU.createFile, CCU.existsFile, CCU.setUserAckInstallWizard, Room.listAll/getAll/get/listProgramIds, Subsection.listAll/getAll/get/listProgramIds; USER = system.saveObjectModel/getPositionData/getTweak, all 4 Program.*, all 11 SysVar.*, WebUI.setWebUIColors, CCU.setSecurityHint, User.getUserFirstName/getUserName/hasUserPWD/isNoExpert/getLanguage/setLanguage/setReGaVersion; ADMIN = ReGa.runScript, ReGa.getAllDatapoints, Room.addChannel/removeChannel, Subsection.addChannel/removeChannel, Firewall.getConfiguration/setConfiguration, SafeMode.enter, all other CCU.* (27 methods), User.existsCertificate/deleteCertificate/restartLighttpd/restartHmIPServer/stopHmIPServer/startHmIPServer (happy path: read table)
edge_cases: WHEN a method with LEVEL other than NONE is invoked without params._session_id_ THEN checkPrivilegeLevel dereferences args(_session_id_) and a Tcl error becomes error 200 'internal error:' (homematic.cgi:110,155); this affects ReGa.getAllDatapoints and Session.setSessionVar whose ARGUMENTS omit _session_id_ (methods.conf:483-488,804-809)

WHEN METHOD_LIST entries contain non-ASCII INFO text (ISO-8859-1 source) THEN json_toString passes the characters through and jsonrpc_response applies encoding convertto utf-8 (describe.tcl:32, jsonrpc.tcl:75)
describe.tcl declares the response key 'summary' while listmethods.tcl uses the key 'info' for the same INFO text (describe.tcl:32 vs listmethods.tcl:26)
WebUI.getColors declares ARGUMENTS { } (a single space) and ReGa.getAllDatapoints declares ARGUMENTS {} although it is ADMIN (methods.conf:483-488,959-964)
WHEN the registry GET page is requested without authentication THEN the same list is served as HTML (homematic.cgi:160-192; dispatcher partition)

USER level can delete Programs and SysVars by name (Program.deleteProgramByName methods.conf:832, SysVar.deleteSysVarByName methods.conf:904) while room/subsection membership edits and Firewall/SSH/ReGa.runScript require ADMIN

user_stories.goal: User profile and preference queries (User.getUserName, getUserFirstName, hasUserPWD, isNoExpert, getLanguage, setLanguage, getReGaVersion, setReGaVersion) read ReGa user objects and per-user/profile files
requirements: GIVEN userID of an existing ReGa user WHEN User.getUserName (USER, methods.conf:1205-1210) runs THEN hmscript returns 'NAME {<user.Name()>}' and the script responds with the literal text {"UserName" : "<name>"}.UserName (getusername.tcl:12-30); User.getUserFirstName does the same with user.UserFirstName() (getuserfirstname.tcl:12-30) (happy path)

GIVEN userID of an existing user WHEN User.hasUserPWD (USER, methods.conf:1212-1217) runs THEN the response text is {"UserPWD" :  true|false }.UserPWD depending on user.UserPwd() == "" (hasuserpwd.tcl:12-38) (happy path)
GIVEN id WHEN User.isNoExpert (USER) runs THEN the raw output of user.UserEasyLinkMode() is returned unquoted, or the literal false when the object does not exist (isnoexpert.tcl:12-24) (happy path)

GIVEN userName and userLang WHEN User.setLanguage (USER, methods.conf:1231-1236) runs THEN the file /etc/config/userprofiles/<file tail of userName>.lang is overwritten with userLang without trailing newline and true is returned (setlanguage.tcl:14-25) (happy path)
GIVEN the profile directory is not writable WHEN User.setLanguage runs THEN jsonrpc_error 500 'could not write user profile' (setlanguage.tcl:17-23) (failure path)

GIVEN userID that does not resolve to a ReGa object WHEN User.getUserName / getUserFirstName / hasUserPWD runs THEN hmscript prints 'false', 'array set user' receives a one-element list and Tcl raises 'list must have an even number of elements', returned as error 200 'internal error:' (getusername.tcl:20,24; getuserfirstname.tcl:20,24; hasuserpwd.tcl:27,32) (failure path)

GIVEN /etc/config/ReGaHssVersion is missing WHEN User.getReGaVersion (NONE, methods.conf:1238-1243) runs THEN it returns the JSON string "COMMUNITY"; first line is used otherwise and the value LEGACY is mapped to COMMUNITY (getregaversion.tcl:10-26) (happy path)

GIVEN ReGaVersion WHEN User.setReGaVersion (USER, methods.conf:1245-1250) runs THEN the value is echoed into /etc/config/ReGaHssVersion via exec echo > file with no validation and the response is null (setregaversion.tcl:11-13) (happy path)
edge_cases: WHEN User.getUserName/getUserFirstName/hasUserPWD respond THEN the result text is a JavaScript expression with a trailing '.UserName'/'.UserPWD' member access, i.e. not valid JSON; the classic client eval()s responses (getusername.tcl:30, hasuserpwd.tcl:38, jsonrpc.js:66,90)

WHEN User.getLanguage (USER, methods.conf:1225-1229) runs THEN it resolves userID to user.UserFirstName() (not Name()) and reads /etc/config/userprofiles/<UserFirstName>.lang, returning the first line unquoted or '0' when the file cannot be opened (getlanguage.tcl:11-25), while User.setLanguage keys the file on the caller-supplied userName (setlanguage.tcl:14-15)

WHEN User.setLanguage receives a userName with path components THEN 'file tail' strips them so the file always lands in /etc/config/userprofiles (setlanguage.tcl:14-15); User.getLanguage builds its path from the ReGa first name without such a strip (getlanguage.tcl:17)
WHEN a language value is non-numeric (e.g. 'de') THEN User.getLanguage returns it as a bare token via jsonrpc_response [lindex $lang 0], which is not valid JSON (getlanguage.tcl:25)
WHEN User.setReGaVersion is called with a value containing leading '-' THEN exec echo may treat it as an echo option; there is no whitelist of values (setregaversion.tcl:11)
WHEN User.getReGaVersion has ReGaHssVersion file with first line LEGACY THEN COMMUNITY is returned (getregaversion.tcl:22-24)
stale root copies www/api/methods/user/setlanguage.tcl and setregaversion.tcl differ from src/webui/www/api/methods (diff -rq)

input_shape.userID: string ReGa object id (getUserFirstName/getUserName/hasUserPWD/getLanguage; ARGUMENTS names userID in methods.conf:1198-1229)

output_shape.getUserName.result: JS expression text evaluating to string
output_shape.hasUserPWD.result: JS expression text evaluating to boolean
output_shape.getLanguage.result: unquoted first line of .lang file, default 0

user_stories.goal: Lifecycle and certificate control: service restarts (lighttpd, HmIP server, sshd, ReGa), certificate presence/removal and SafeMode.enter reboot, all ADMIN-level
requirements: GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN User.restartLighttpd (methods.conf:1266-1271) runs THEN 'exec /usr/bin/monit restart lighttpd' is executed synchronously and the response is true (restartlighttpd.tcl:10-12) (happy path)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN User.restartHmIPServer / stopHmIPServer / startHmIPServer run THEN '/usr/bin/nohup /etc/init.d/S62HMServer restart|stop|start >/dev/null &' is started in the background and true is returned immediately (restarthmipserver.tcl:11-12, stophmipserver.tcl:10-11, starthmipserver.tcl:10-11) (happy path)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN CCU.restartReGa (methods.conf:1082-1087) or CCU.restartSSHDaemon (methods.conf:1075-1080) run THEN 'monit restart ReGaHss' / 'monit restart sshd' is executed inside catch and the response result is null (restartReGa.tcl:10-12, restartsshdaemon.tcl:10-12) (happy path)

GIVEN /etc/config/server.pem exists WHEN User.existsCertificate (ADMIN, methods.conf:1252-1257) runs THEN true, else false (existscertificate.tcl:10-16); User.deleteCertificate (ADMIN) deletes /etc/config/server.pem inside catch and always returns true (deletecertificate.tcl:10-12) (happy path)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN SafeMode.enter (methods.conf:973-978, ARGUMENTS {_session_id_}) runs THEN /etc/config/safemode is written containing '1', ReGa persists with 'rega system.Save()', a background '/sbin/reboot -d 2' is launched and true is returned (enter.tcl:12-23) (happy path)
GIVEN /etc/config is not writable WHEN SafeMode.enter runs THEN open raises a Tcl error, no reboot is triggered and the caller receives error 200 'internal error:' (enter.tcl:15) (failure path)
GIVEN the monit binary or restart command fails WHEN User.restartLighttpd runs THEN exec raises, uncaught, and error 200 'internal error:' is returned (restartlighttpd.tcl:10) (failure path)
edge_cases: WHEN User.restartLighttpd restarts the web server that is serving the CGI request THEN the response may never reach the client; the call is not detached or backgrounded (restartlighttpd.tcl:10)

WHEN SafeMode.enter is called THEN the documented 'paasword' parameter is neither declared in ARGUMENTS nor read by the script (enter.tcl:6, methods.conf:977); the stale root copy www/api/methods/safemode/enter.tcl differs
WHEN User.deleteCertificate is called and the file does not exist THEN the response is still true (deletecertificate.tcl:10-12)
WHEN CCU.restartReGa/restartSSHDaemon fail THEN the failure is swallowed by catch and the result is null (restartReGa.tcl:10-12)
Header comments of restartlighttpd/start/stopHmIPServer all say 'Lighttpd Webserver' although the HmIP scripts control init script S62HMServer (restarthmipserver.tcl:3-4,11)

output_shape.result: boolean true (restartLighttpd, *HmIPServer, deleteCertificate, SafeMode.enter) | boolean (existsCertificate) | null (restartReGa, restartSSHDaemon)

user_stories.goal: CCU.createFile and CCU.existsFile let a GUEST-level session touch / probe any filesystem path (filesystem primitives used by the classic UI for flag files)
requirements: GIVEN GUEST session and file='/etc/config/x' WHEN CCU.createFile (LEVEL GUEST, ARGUMENTS {_session_id_ file}, methods.conf:1102-1107) runs THEN 'exec touch $args(file)' is executed and, if the exec returned no output, the response is true (createfile.tcl:13-21) (happy path)

GIVEN a path whose directory does not exist WHEN CCU.createFile runs THEN touch writes to stderr, Tcl exec raises, the catch stores the message in e and the response is false (createfile.tcl:15-19) (failure path)
GIVEN file path WHEN CCU.existsFile (GUEST, methods.conf:1109-1114) runs THEN the response is true if Tcl 'file exists' is 1 (file or directory), else false (existsfile.tcl:10-16) (happy path)
GIVEN missing 'file' argument WHEN either method runs THEN 402 'missing argument (file)' (homematic.cgi:127-130) (failure path)
edge_cases: WHEN file begins with '-' THEN it is passed to touch as an option because no '--' guard is used (createfile.tcl:15)
WHEN file is an empty string THEN touch reports a missing operand and the result is false (createfile.tcl:15-19)

WHEN createFile is invoked THEN the file is created with the CGI process's identity and mtime updated if it already exists; no path whitelist or traversal check exists for either method (createfile.tcl:15, existsfile.tcl:12)
In-repo consumers: securityHint.js:4 and installWizard.js:43 call CCU.existsFile with /etc/config flag files; ise/js/functions.js uses CCU.createFile (grep of src/webui)

output_shape.result: boolean (createFile: true if touch printed nothing; existsFile: file exists)

user_stories.goal: SSH management: CCU.setSSH, CCU.getSSHState, CCU.setSSHPassword (ADMIN) toggle the sshEnabled flag file, report its presence and replace root's password hash in /etc/config/shadow
requirements: GIVEN mode == 'true' WHEN CCU.setSSH (ADMIN, methods.conf:1028-1032) runs THEN '/etc/config/sshEnabled' is created via touch, otherwise (any other value) removed via rm, both inside catch; then /bin/setfirewall.tcl is sourced to reload and apply the firewall; result null (setssh.tcl:11-21) (happy path)
GIVEN the flag file exists WHEN CCU.getSSHState (ADMIN, methods.conf:1034-1038) runs THEN result is 1 else 0 (getsshstate.tcl:10-12) (happy path)

GIVEN passwd WHEN CCU.setSSHPassword (ADMIN, methods.conf:1040-1045) runs THEN 'echo <passwd> | mkpasswd -m sha512' produces a digest, sed -i rewrites the root: line of /etc/config/shadow using the digest, and the response is {"msg":"noError"} when sed printed nothing (setsshpassword.tcl:11-21) (happy path)

GIVEN mkpasswd is missing or fails WHEN CCU.setSSHPassword runs THEN the failing exec at line 11 is outside the catch and the caller gets error 200 'internal error:' (setsshpassword.tcl:11) (failure path)

GIVEN sed fails (e.g. shadow file missing) WHEN CCU.setSSHPassword runs THEN the sed error text is returned in {"msg": <text>} with a normal (non-error) response (setsshpassword.tcl:13-21) (failure path)
GIVEN /bin/setfirewall.tcl fails to source WHEN CCU.setSSH runs THEN the error propagates as 200 'internal error:' after the flag file has already changed (setssh.tcl:19) (failure path)
edge_cases: WHEN mode is the boolean true from JSON THEN it is compared as the string 'true'; anything else (including 'TRUE', 1) disables SSH (setssh.tcl:13)

WHEN passwd contains characters special to the sed 's%...%...%' command such as '%' THEN the substituted command is built by string interpolation of the digest only (setsshpassword.tcl:12); the plain password is never put into the sed command
The cleartext password appears on the command line of echo and as an exec argument (setsshpassword.tcl:11)
stale root copy www/api/methods/ccu/setssh.tcl differs from src/webui/www/api/methods/ccu/setssh.tcl
setsshpassword.tcl line 11 has no '--' before the password; a password starting with '-n' would be consumed by echo as an option

user_stories.goal: CCU.downloadFirmware (ADMIN) downloads the latest CCU2/CCU3 firmware tarball over HTTPS with wget into /tmp/fup.tgz
requirements: GIVEN /VERSION major version 3 WHEN CCU.downloadFirmware (ADMIN, ARGUMENTS {_session_id_}, methods.conf:1047-1052) runs THEN serial is read from /var/board_serial, the URL https://ccu3-update.homematic.com/firmware/download?cmd=download&version=<v>&serial=<s>&lang=de&product=HM-CCU3 is built (downloadFirmware.tcl:11-15) and wget -q --https-only -O /tmp/fup.tgz <url> is run; exit 0 returns true (downloadFirmware.tcl:24-31) (happy path)

GIVEN major version 2 WHEN the method runs THEN serial comes from /sys/module/plat_eq3ccu2/parameters/board_serial and https://update.homematic.com/... product=HM-CCU2 is used (downloadFirmware.tcl:16-18) (happy path)
GIVEN wget fails WHEN the method runs THEN the error text is written to /tmp/dwnld.error and the response is false (downloadFirmware.tcl:24-34) (failure path)

GIVEN major version neither 2 nor 3 WHEN the method runs THEN 'nomatch' is appended to /tmp/test and jsonrpc_response false is written, but because jsonrpc_response does not exit the script continues, the wget invocation fails on the undefined $url inside catch, and a second jsonrpc_response false is emitted, so two concatenated response documents are printed (downloadFirmware.tcl:19-33; jsonrpc.tcl:72-94) (failure path)
edge_cases: WHEN /VERSION does not contain a VERSION= line THEN the grep|sed pipeline errors are only stored in the unchecked catch result and $version/$major carry the error message (downloadFirmware.tcl:11-12)
WHEN the request is served THEN lang=de and the product name are hard-coded (downloadFirmware.tcl:15,18)
WHEN a previous /tmp/fup.tgz exists THEN wget -O overwrites it; no size, checksum or signature check is performed in this method (downloadFirmware.tcl:24)
WHEN the download takes long THEN the CGI blocks synchronously until wget returns (no timeout argument) (downloadFirmware.tcl:24)

user_stories.goal: ReGa bridge methods: ReGa.runScript (ADMIN) executes arbitrary HomeMatic script, ReGa.isPresent (NONE) probes ReGa, ReGa.getAllDatapoints (ADMIN) dumps all ReGa objects

WHEN script output contains '/' THEN it is escaped as '\/' (json.tcl:207)

user_stories.goal: WebUI colour theme: WebUI.getColors (NONE) merges the system and user colour maps; WebUI.setWebUIColors (USER) rewrites the user colour map

GIVEN neither colour file is readable WHEN WebUI.getColors runs THEN loadFromFile returns '' and the result is {} (getcolors.tcl:17-27,36-43) (failure path)

GIVEN key, color and cpFile WHEN WebUI.setWebUIColors (USER, methods.conf:966-971) runs THEN /etc/config/color.map is seeded by copying the system color.map when absent (setwebuicolor.tcl:22-24), then rewritten line by line, replacing any line whose first token equals key (split by space, or by tab/'?') with '<key>  <color>', and true is returned (setwebuicolor.tcl:26-43) (happy path)

GIVEN the system colour map cannot be copied or /etc/config is read-only WHEN WebUI.setWebUIColors runs THEN exec/open raise and the caller gets 200 'internal error:' (setwebuicolor.tcl:23,27,32) (failure path)
edge_cases: WHEN key does not exist in the map THEN no line is added and the response is still true (setwebuicolor.tcl:33-40,41)

WHEN setWebUIColors runs THEN the file is first truncated via 'exec echo "" > file' (leaving an initial blank line) and then rebuilt with one 'exec echo' append per line; the sequence is not atomic and a failure mid-way leaves a truncated file (setwebuicolor.tcl:32-39)
WHEN cpFile is passed THEN it is read into a variable but never used (setwebuicolor.tcl:16); it is still required by ARGUMENTS (methods.conf:970)
WHEN color is not a '#rrggbb' string THEN it is not validated and is written as-is (setwebuicolor.tcl:35)
WHEN central is false (CfgTool variant) THEN getColors ignores the user override file (getcolors.tcl:32-34)
WHEN a colour value or key contains JSON-special characters THEN json_toString escapes them (getcolors.tcl:41)

user_stories.goal: Firewall configuration: Firewall.getConfiguration and Firewall.setConfiguration (ADMIN) read and apply services access, allowed IPs, user ports and mode via /lib/libfirewall.tcl
requirements: GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Firewall.getConfiguration (methods.conf:945-950) runs THEN /lib/libfirewall.tcl loads /etc/config/firewall.conf and the result is {services:[{id,access,ports:[int]}],ips:[string],userports:[string],mode:string} (getconfiguration.tcl:23-78); service defaults are XMLRPC, REGA, NEOSERVER, SNMP with access 'none', default mode RESTRICTIVE, default IPs 192.168.0.1 192.168.0.0/16 fc00::/7 (libfirewall.tcl:26-30,53,69) (happy path)

GIVEN services, ips, userports, mode WHEN Firewall.setConfiguration (ADMIN, methods.conf:952-957) runs THEN the stored IPS and USER_PORTS are replaced, Firewall_setMode is applied, access of every known service listed in 'services' (matched by service.name) is replaced, the configuration is saved to /etc/config/firewall.conf and Firewall_configureFirewall applies it immediately; true is returned (setconfiguration.tcl:20-53) (happy path)

GIVEN mode is neither 'MOST_OPEN' nor 'RESTRICTIVE' WHEN Firewall.setConfiguration runs THEN Firewall_setMode prints 'Firewall_setMode: Unsupported mode.' to stdout (before the HTTP headers), keeps the previous mode and processing continues (libfirewall.tcl:228-240) (failure path)

GIVEN a services element without a 'name' key WHEN Firewall.setConfiguration runs THEN $service(name) raises and the caller gets 200 'internal error:' while config in memory is partly modified but not saved (setconfiguration.tcl:34-38,50) (failure path)
edge_cases: WHEN getConfiguration emits services THEN the identifier key is 'id' (getconfiguration.tcl:38) but setConfiguration reads 'name' (setconfiguration.tcl:37); callers must translate
WHEN a services element names an unknown service THEN it is silently ignored (setconfiguration.tcl:40)
WHEN access is not one of full|restricted|none THEN it is stored unvalidated in firewall.conf (setconfiguration.tcl:38,42; libfirewall.tcl:215)
WHEN ips or userports contain arbitrary strings THEN they are written unvalidated as Tcl lists into firewall.conf ('IPs = ...', 'USERPORTS = ...') (libfirewall.tcl:199-207)
WHEN the services array order is returned THEN it follows Tcl 'array names' order, which is not stable (getconfiguration.tcl:32)
WHEN firewall.conf is absent THEN defaults apply (libfirewall.tcl:93-127)
WHEN Firewall_loadConfiguration migrates missing default ports THEN it rewrites firewall.conf as a side effect of a read-only getConfiguration call (libfirewall.tcl:141-149,174-176)
WHEN a service id in firewall.conf is unknown to the built-in table THEN '$Firewall_SERVICES($id)' raises on load (libfirewall.tcl:139)
